name: MALVIN-XD
description: MALVIN-XD, A Multi Device Whatsapp Bot built by Malvin Tech to Enhance Whatsapp Communication Experience

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session ID. Get it at session.malvintech.sbs/pair?bot=malvin

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner's WhatsApp number (with country code, no + or spaces)

TIME_ZONE.description: Timezone used for time-based features (e.g. Africa/Lagos)

AUTO_READ_STATUS.description: Mark incoming WhatsApp statuses as read

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string. Falls back to local SQLite if not set
